تستصرخوا (form X)
# تَسْتَصْرِخُوا (tastaṣriḵū) /tas.tasˤ.ri.xuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْرَخَ (istaṣraḵa)
# تُسْتَصْرَخُوا (tustaṣraḵū) /tus.tasˤ.ra.xuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْرَخَ (istaṣraḵa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
